description: House members will enter the third week of the 2023 Regular Session on Monday.In the second week, several bills passed the House and are now making their way to the Senate.On Wednesday, the House passed HB1018. This bill will allow members of municipal fire department bomb squads to carry weapons while responding to bomb threats.The House also passed HB1086.
